en: Add Shared capabilities → MCP connections for individual Codex accounts, with a ChatCut shortcut and custom HTTPS service configuration.

Support browser sign-in, configuration/authentication status refresh and cancellation. Credentials remain with the selected CLI account; tool operation must be verified in a task. Claude, Grok and Gemini external MCP support is unchanged.
zh: 新增“共享能力 → MCP 连接”，可按 Codex 账号添加 ChatCut 或自定义 HTTPS 服务。
支持浏览器登录授权、刷新配置与授权状态及取消操作。凭据保留在所选 CLI 账号，实际工具调用需在任务中验证；Claude、Grok、Gemini 的外部 MCP 支持范围不变。
